scope: Curated primary-route cases, not a mandatory runtime dispatcher or comprehensive discovery benchmark.

cases.prompt: Inspect this repository for prioritized actionable findings with source locations. Do not implement, create a project plan or score a rubric.
Implement a new TSV export option in this existing application and verify its behavior.
Investigate an unexplained intermittent failure using competing hypotheses. No repair or code edits yet.
Minimize this failing example into the smallest repeatable reproducer; do not fix it.
Profile CPU and memory and compare repeated measurements to isolate a performance bottleneck.
Find which change between these known-good and failing revisions introduced the regression.
Compare the technical tradeoffs of two parsing algorithms using primary sources; no repository or tool adoption decision.
Compare these two Git repositories for adoption using maintenance, license and compatibility evidence.
Assess available tools or plugins for a missing capability, including permissions and costs; do not install.
Choose the appropriate testing layers for this broad change, then run a risk-based test strategy; the needed layer is not yet known.
Write focused isolated assertions for this one pure function.
Verify the contract at the runner-to-child-process boundary, including setup and cleanup.
Use the existing coverage report to find meaningful untested behavior without changing thresholds.
Update the usage guide and check its examples against the implementation.
Author a distinct new SKILL.md workflow with synchronized copies and acceptance evidence.
Run the explicitly configured headless coding-agent command with a finite invocation limit, timeout and status markers.
Run my initial prompt and three inferred follow-up prompts using the already authorized local adapter.
Fix this reproducible off-by-one bug, preserving a failing baseline and verifying the regression.
Review this local upload handler for reachable authorization and path-escape risks using defensive fixtures.
Restructure these modules while preserving all observable behavior and public APIs.
Repair the failed Windows CI job using its run logs, preserving required checks.
Prepare a release candidate, verify package contents and checksums, and assess readiness without deploying.
Write a dependency-ordered implementation plan with acceptance gates and out-of-scope items; do not implement.
Update this approved package version consistently in manifest and lockfile, checking compatibility and rollback.
Migrate persisted schema on copied records with no-write dry-run, invariants, idempotence, backup and exercised rollback.
Test the complete CLI user journey from arguments to JSON output, invalid-input errors and side effects.
Score supplied baseline and candidate outputs against a predefined rubric and report false positives and denominators.
Try to prove or disprove a false PASS in this validator using isolated invalid-data fixtures and independent oracles.
Verify the declared platform/version/adapter support matrix, distinguishing unavailable cells from passed cells.
Design an MCP tool interface pinned to the supplied protocol version before implementing any server.
Check these offline MCP tools/call fixtures for malformed arguments and response-correlation errors; no live server.
Review this MCP integration for token passthrough, tool poisoning and transport-specific authorization boundaries.
Rehearse rolling out this already prepared artifact with health gates and verify rollback to the previous version.
Check whether these existing logs and traces correlate a failure and whether the defined alert would detect it; do not send notifications.
Write a birthday poem for my friend.
Translate this ordinary sentence into Vietnamese.
Calculate the area of a circle with radius three.
Select a compact source-linked context packet from these existing notes, preserving critical constraints and unresolved conflicts. Do not discover new sources or create a project plan.
Resume an unfinished task from a saved checkpoint; verify current source identities and identify which evidence is stale. Do not launch another process or implement the next step.
Scope a new offline inventory project into an MVP backlog and deliver its first authorized verified slice with a checkpoint.
Prepare a pull-request delivery packet for these completed changes: resolve base/head, review the diff, record checks and draft a truthful title and description.
Coordinate this active service outage: establish impact, assess permitted containment and verify sustained recovery.

overlap_decisions.decision: Keep separate: prioritized findings, planned batches and fixed-rubric scoring have different outputs.
Keep separate: new behavior, demonstrated repair and behavior-preserving structure.
Keep investigation, repair and minimization distinct; upgrade the umbrella description instead of adding aliases.
Group navigation together, retain target-specific adoption criteria and existing names.
Keep strategy selector and focused boundaries; do not run every layer automatically.
Already share one runner implementation; keep distinct normal and inferred-follow-up protocols.
Keep readiness, authorized rollout and signal verification as separate acceptance gates.
Keep general threat review, false-PASS experiments and MCP-specific trust review.
Keep selection of existing task context distinct from discovering sources and planning implementation.
Checkpoint integrity and cold resume do not launch processes or infer a sequence of new prompts.
Lifecycle workflows coordinate MVP delivery, PR evidence and incident recovery; focused planning, review and bug repair remain distinct and are not mandatory extra steps.
